newsitem.title: JAPAN: Weak stocks may be behind BOJ easy stance - analysts.
newsitem.headline: Weak stocks may be behind BOJ easy stance - analysts.

text.p: Worries about Japanese stock prices before the fiscal year-end on March 31 may be partly responsible for the Bank of Japan's (BOJ) accommodative stance in the Tokyo money market, analysts and traders said on Monday.
The BOJ conducted another generous money market operation on Monday morning, injecting 300 billion yen when only 200 billion yen was needed to make up a shortfall.
The BOJ conducted an accommodative operation on Friday for the first time since August 7, 1996.
The central bank declined to comment about this morning's money market operation.
